title: Walking in the Spirit
definition: Walking in the Spirit means living daily under the Spirit's direction, power, and influence instead of following the desires of the flesh.
summary: The Christian life is not lived by human strength alone. Believers are called to depend on the Spirit, resist sin, and follow Christ in daily obedience.
christFocus: The Spirit leads believers in the way of Christ, forming His character in them.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Christian life is not lived by human strength alone. Believers are called to depend on the Spirit, resist sin, and follow Christ in daily obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
